message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the loaded dataset or command-line arguments beyond basic string lowercasing and int casting.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local file path (os.path.join with param['data_path']) with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity check of any kind.
No detected label flipping detection: There is no code that validates label values, compares label distributions, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation only performs standard scaling (StandardScaler/MinMaxScaler) with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads serialized data via torch.load() without any hash/signature verification, and the cont_loaded flag for loading existing saved models has no integrity check implemented.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distributions, class balance, or anomalous samples before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: The code uses a standard Adam optimizer with no differential privacy library (Opacus, TF Privacy, DP-SGD) integrated.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While train/valid/test splits are loaded separately, the test_loader is shuffled (shuffle=True) which is unusual, there is no hashing/signing of evaluation data, and no evidence of multiple independent metrics or isolation guarantees beyond simple dataset splits.

No detected input sanitization: No input shape, range, or schema validation is performed on incoming data before it is passed to the model; data is loaded and scaled but not validated for correctness or malformed inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no checks on model outputs for NaN values, out-of-range predictions, or probability sanity bounds anywhere in the visible inference path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a multimodal sentiment regression model (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
